workflow_tests.source: All workflow.test.js scenarios passed in the final full suite.

last_focused_backend_run.note: Before the final archived-competition scenario was added.

failures: public football directories retain the public shell while portal roots remain isolated
normal-user account, role gates, and public discovery remain explicitly routed
USER profile update binds exclusively to req.user and returns a safe authoritative projection
profile validation follows the existing name, phone, and URL conventions
valid password change rehashes only the authenticated account and new credentials replace old credentials
account profile and password UI remain guarded, refresh shared auth state, and never persist passwords
dashboard composes only the owned-club aggregate result set
empty owned club dashboard is deterministic and contains no foreign results
club-owner eligible teams are derived from authenticated ownership and exclude foreign teams
public club routes, shared navigation, and client service keep the directory unauthenticated and server-backed
admin season detail is bounded and handles malformed or missing IDs
season update protects schedule history and lifecycle uses conditional status changes
